name: Haruman -Just One Day-
source:
Set in modern day South Korea, you'll be playing as a stylist who's running late for a very important event and gets to spend a day with a member of a rookie idol group, called QUAR'X!

This visual novel is loosely inspired on Bangtan Sonyeondan (방탄소년단)'s song, "Just One Day" (하루만, "Haruman").

[From [url=https://ppppantsu.itch.io/haruman]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在现代韩国。你将扮演一位造型师，正赶着去参加一场非常重要的活动，却快要迟到了。在这一天里，你将与新人偶像团体QUAR'X的一名成员共度时光！

这部视觉小说的创作灵感大致来自防弹少年团（방탄소년단）的歌曲《只一天》（하루만，罗马字：Haruman；英文名：Just One Day）。

（来源：[url=https://ppppantsu.itch.io/haruman]itch.io[/url]）
